claims.quote: SNAREopathies constitute a group of severe genetic neurodevelopmental disorders caused by de novo variants that disturb the synaptic release machinery.
These neurodevelopmental disorders comprise highly diverse clinical phenotypes, usually including developmental delay, epilepsy, intellectual disability and sometimes autism spectrum disorder.
